meta.subtitle: Updated MYP PT Schedule V2: Thu 11 correction applied — 6E does not test on Thu 11; 7C goes directly to F2-07 with Natalie; 6E cover with Liam P4 only. 8A PTMBOTH Mon 22 update applied. PTE triple update applied. Shadow Day/G8 event update applied. Saeed Tue P8 / Sarum Wed cover update applied.

notes.html: 8C PTE Part 2 rescheduled: moved to Tue 23 Jun P9–P10 in F1-06 — Sarum Shah's own 8C English double, so no cover. This frees her to start 8E.PTM2 at P7 on Wed 17. 8E.PTM2: Sarum Shah starts P7 in F2-10 (David Barton's room); David takes over P8.

6D PTE Part 2 scheduled: Mon 22 Jun P4–P5 in F1-08. Cherisse Corbie starts P4 (her English lesson); Sunandhini Subramanian supervises P5 (her Maths period with 6D) in the same room. No cover, no room change. 8D Wed 17: Fiona Williams supervises the final period (P9) — her own CONNECTED lesson with 8D; Melanie Reeve covers P7–P8.

6D PTE update: 6D now sits Part 1 only on Wed 17 Jun P3–P4 with Cherisse Corbie in F1-08 — her own English double, so no cover, no room move, and no mid-session changeover. The previous PTEBOTH triple (which needed Saeed Smith to cover the P5 Arabic period) has been removed.

Source correction: This version has been rechecked using MYPXML 2025_26, not the later-year timetable. The PT schedule windows were left unchanged because the viewer was already structured around the 10-period 2025_26 day.

David Barton corrections applied: 8E no longer tests during Tue 9 P8. 8E are relocated to Science in B2-01 while David remains with 7B.PTMBOTH. 8E.PTM1 is now Wed 10 P8. 8E.PTM2 is now Wed 17 P7–P8 with Saeed/cover starting and David finishing supervision. 8F.PTM2 remains Wed 10 P9–P10 in F2-10. 8C.PTMBOTH has a P4 cover note because David is in Fire Training.
Blocked as overflow: Arabic, UAESS, MSC, iStudy, PHE, Design, French and Spanish. Allowed: InS. Exception: 6G.PTEBOTH accepted.

Cross-core supervision rule: when a test continues into a second core subject lesson, the second-subject teacher may continue supervision of the testing class so the first teacher can return to normal timetable duties if required.
Schedule update v2: rejected the earlier 8D.PTM1 Tue P8 suggestion; added a split 7C make-up plan; all moved sessions now show “reprint codes” notes and clearer affected-lesson context.

Wed 10 handover check: Mohammed Gias M. Gias is normally with 8B for P3–P4 Maths only. The P5 period is 8B InS with Ashli Nelson, so Ashli should release Gias and supervise the final period of 8B.PTMBOTH in F2-06.
7E.PTM2 update: moved to Wed 10 Jun. Ryan Samuel starts the session during P1 in F2-07; Natalie Oliver-Caldwell continues during P2–P3 in F2-07.
Thu 11 correction: 6E.PTM2 removed from Thu 11. 7C.PTMBoth goes directly to F2-07 with Natalie from P4. 6E goes to Liam Melville for P4 cover only. 6E.PTM2 is moved to Thu 18 Jun P3–P4.
8A PTM update: Friday P3 8A.PTM1 and the separate Thu 25 8A.PTM2 moved session are replaced by one 8A.PTMBOTH session on Mon 22 Jun P8–P10 in F2-06.

PTE triple update: combined the available PTE doubles into protected triples where indicated. RED rows identify cover that is not clean because the displaced teacher still has other students to teach.
Lunch-span check for 8E–9B: 8E and 8F still have PTE2 as a lunch-spanning double on Mon 22 P5/P7. 9A and 9B remain as Thu 25 P8–P10 blocks, so no lunch-spanning double is required for them.

Shadow Day / G8 availability update: Tue 16 Shadow Day teachers are not available for PT coverage; Fri 19 P1–P3 is treated as a hard MYP assembly blackout; Wed 17 P3 Grade 8 assembly removes 8A.PTS from that slot.
